# MG Ghanbari

> Portfolio of MG Ghanbari (Massimo Javer), a 3D and VFX artist, filmmaker and
> developer. Film VFX and compositing, character and creature work, Unreal
> Engine environments, cinematic animation, AI production pipelines, and
> shipped mobile and web apps. Available for character art, environment and set
> work, animation, VFX and simulation, cinematic and game/app work.

## Portfolio — VFX & 3D Art

- [Precision Strike: The Silent Sniper](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/precision-strike): cinematic sniper sequence — layout, lighting and compositing
- [Character Animation Showreel](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/character-animation-showreel): character animation reel with performance and body mechanics
- [Marvelous Designer Showreel](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/marvelous-designer): cloth simulation and garment work reel
- [Unreal Engine: Interactive Modern Villa Exploration](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/modern-villa): real-time architectural walkthrough built in Unreal Engine
- [Molten Flow: A Liquid Simulation Study](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/molten-flow): liquid and molten material simulation study
- [Visual Alchemy: Transforming Concepts into 3D Reality](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/visual-alchemy): concept-to-3D production breakdown
- [Statue Street Fight](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/statue-street-fight): stylised character and action piece
- [ZBrush Sculpt — Angry Dude](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/zbrush-sculpt): digital sculpture and character bust
- [Unreal Engine: A History Rendered](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/a-history-rendered): cinematic short film made in Unreal Engine
- [News Animation](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/news-animation): stylised broadcast characters for animated news segments
- [Arcane Like — Break the Unknown](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/arcane-like): stylised cinematic in an Arcane-inspired look

## AI & Automation

- [Ghan Cinematic — AI Film Studio](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/ai/ghan-cinematic): end-to-end cinematic pipeline — script to 10s shot breakdown to identity-locked keyframes to video, routed across 10 providers (local Qwen/ComfyUI or cloud Grok, Gemini, OpenAI, Replicate) with per-shot retries

## Apps & Games

- [Sentinel Vanguard](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/sentinel-vanguard): 3D space combat with hangar loadouts, shields, hull, bombs and boss fights
- [Aether Architect](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/aether-architect): third-person Unreal Engine 5.8 adventure for Android — floating islands, crystal pickups, motion-matching locomotion
- [Harmony Heart Pro (NVC Edition)](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/harmony-heart-pro): AI Non-Violent Communication coach for couples, Gemini-driven, five languages, Android
- [Recipe Roulette](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/recipe-roulette): decide dinner in one spin — mood, energy, cuisine, diet and time cap into a full recipe card
- [Podcast Discovery Wheel](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/podcast-discovery-wheel): spin a dial to get one podcast episode with an AI summary instead of an endless feed
- [Orbit Defender](https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/orbit-defender): top-down space shooter for Android — scatter, laser and plasma weapons, shields, boss encounters
